name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Carry the box to the exit' is correctly captured by hard Existence(at_exit) plus hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), the standard carry-to pattern — the machine's only final state u3 is entered only while holding_box on the exit step, so the box must be in hand when the episode ends at the exit. 'If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box): u1 after a fall either returns to the flow on a holding_box step or falls into the rejecting state u6 otherwise. Every clause traces to a task sentence, all priorities are hard as the wording demands, and no requirement is added or omitted.

texts: Whenever the agent is at the exit, the agent is holding the box.
Whenever the box falls, the agent is holding the box again on the very next step.
